svg.title: Hi, I'm Phurpa
svg.desc: Software Engineer and AI/ML Engineer from Bhutan, passionate about building practical technology solutions through artificial intelligence, software development, and cybersecurity. Founder & CEO of Northuen, Team Lead at TechWiz (ZhingScan), and Bhutan Country Chairperson of the G17 University Ambassadors Consortium. Interested in emerging technologies, secure systems, and entrepreneurship.
